data.name: Orangie
data.detailed_description:
Orangie is an ultra-rare 3D AI desktop pet. She lives on your desktop, chats with you, interacts with you, and performs cute actions ฅ(＾・ω・＾ฅ)

Her main feature is “game companionship.” Whether you are progressing through the story, fighting bosses, farming dungeons, or exploring maps, she will watch the story with you, get nervous with you, and joke about what is happening. She will celebrate when you play well, quietly tease you when you nearly fail, and stay by your side during emotional moments as if she were truly sitting next to you.

Orangie includes many adorable and distinctive personalities. You may meet a gentle but slightly mischievous , a sweet Japanese-style, and many other desktop companions. Each personality has its own speaking style, emotional expression, and way of keeping you company. One of them is sure to capture your heart～(๑•̀ㅂ•́)و✧

Voice is also an important part of the experience. With high-quality voice performance, the characters do more than simply speak—they express real emotion, tone, pauses, affection, and playful teasing. Chinese, English, and Japanese are supported, giving you a more natural experience whether you are chatting casually or playing games together.

She can remember the little moments from your games: your favorite characters, the boss that kept you stuck, the story that left you speechless, and the victory that made you take a screenshot. Over time, these moments become shared memories.

In Orangie , you can have one adorable desktop companion or a whole group of AI characters with different personalities, voices, and styles. They will celebrate with you, joke with you, play games with you, and stay by your side whenever you feel like talking to someone.

Let Orangie move onto your desktop. From now on, every game will be an adventure you no longer have to face alone～✧｡٩(ˊᗜˋ)و✧*｡

data.short_description: *Orangie* is a rare 3D AI desktop pet made for gaming companionship. She can chat, interact, perform actions, cheer you on, joke with you, and enjoy game stories together. She supports Chinese, English, and Japanese with high-quality voices. Join her on your next adventure! (ฅ´ω`ฅ)

English*, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit（22H2+）
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 兼容，4 GB 显存
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 兼容，12GB 显存
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
The game contains mild suggestive content. The most revealing costume available is an underwear-style outfit, and some character personalities may occasionally use mildly flirtatious or suggestive dialogue.

There are no depictions of sexual acts, explicit nudity, sexual assault, or non-consensual sexual content. The game does not contain extreme violence, drug or alcohol abuse, self-harm, or other sensitive themes that may cause significant discomfort to players.
